100.question: What does NFL stand for?
100.explanation: The National Football League, founded in 1920, is the top professional American football league.

200.question: What team won the first two Super Bowls under coach Vince Lombardi?
200.explanation: Vince Lombardi's Green Bay Packers won Super Bowls I and II, beating the AFL's Kansas City Chiefs and Oakland Raiders.

300.question: What legendary Green Bay coach is the Super Bowl trophy named after?
300.explanation: The Super Bowl trophy was named the Vince Lombardi Trophy after his death in 1970, honoring the coach who won the first two Super Bowls.

400.question: What NFL team is known for having won the 1972 season with a perfect record?
400.explanation: The 1972 Miami Dolphins went 17-0, including a Super Bowl VII win. They are still the only team to finish an NFL season undefeated and untied.

500.question: What rival league merged with the NFL after helping create the Super Bowl matchup?
500.explanation: The American Football League agreed in 1966 to merge with the NFL. The two leagues' champions began meeting in what became the Super Bowl.

100.question: What game is now officially known as Super Bowl I?
100.explanation: The first AFL-NFL World Championship Game, in January 1967, saw Green Bay beat Kansas City 35-10. It was later renamed Super Bowl I.

200.question: What quarterback famously guaranteed victory for the New York Jets before Super Bowl III?
200.explanation: Broadway Joe Namath guaranteed a win for the AFL's Jets before Super Bowl III, and then delivered one of football's biggest upsets.

300.question: What team did the New York Jets defeat in Super Bowl III?
300.explanation: The New York Jets beat the heavily favored Baltimore Colts 16-7 in Super Bowl III, proving AFL teams could compete with the NFL.

400.question: What year did the AFL-NFL merger officially take effect?
400.explanation: The AFL-NFL merger, agreed in 1966, took full effect in the 1970 season, when the leagues became one NFL.

500.question: What two conferences were formed from the merger structure used by the modern NFL?
answers: american football conference and national football conference
500.explanation: After the merger the NFL split into the American Football Conference (AFC) and National Football Conference (NFC), whose champions meet in the Super Bowl.

100.question: What team won four Super Bowls during the 1970s behind the Steel Curtain defense?
100.explanation: The Pittsburgh Steelers won four Super Bowls in six seasons (1974-1979), powered by the Steel Curtain defense.

200.question: What Steelers quarterback led the team to four Super Bowl wins in the 1970s?
200.explanation: Terry Bradshaw quarterbacked all four of the Steelers' 1970s Super Bowl wins and was MVP of two of them.

300.question: What Dallas Cowboys quarterback was nicknamed Captain Comeback?
300.explanation: Roger Staubach led many late-game rallies, earning the nickname Captain Comeback, and won two Super Bowls with the Cowboys.

400.question: What Raiders coach was famous for the phrase, 'Just win, baby'?
400.explanation: Al Davis coached the Raiders in the 1960s and ran the team for decades. His motto, Just win, baby, defined the franchise.

500.question: What running back became the first NFL player to rush for 2,000 yards in a season?
500.explanation: O.J. Simpson of the Buffalo Bills ran for 2,003 yards in 1973, the first 2,000-yard season, and did it in only 14 games.

100.question: What San Francisco 49ers quarterback won four Super Bowls during the 1980s?
100.explanation: Joe Montana won four Super Bowls with the 49ers and never threw an interception in any of them.

200.question: What wide receiver holds many major NFL receiving records and starred for the 49ers?
200.explanation: Jerry Rice holds the NFL career records for receptions, receiving yards, and touchdown catches, and is widely called the greatest receiver ever.

300.question: What Chicago Bears team is famous for its dominant defense and the Super Bowl Shuffle?
300.explanation: The 1985 Chicago Bears went 15-1 with a crushing 46 defense, recorded the Super Bowl Shuffle, and routed the Patriots 46-10 in Super Bowl XX.

400.question: What Dallas Cowboys trio was nicknamed The Triplets in the 1990s?
answers: troy aikman emmitt smith michael irvin
troy aikman, emmitt smith, and michael irvin
400.explanation: Quarterback Troy Aikman, running back Emmitt Smith, and receiver Michael Irvin led the Cowboys to three Super Bowl wins in four seasons.

500.question: What Buffalo Bills quarterback led the team to four straight Super Bowl appearances in the early 1990s?
500.explanation: Jim Kelly led the Bills to four straight Super Bowls from 1991 to 1994 with the no-huddle offense. They lost all four.

100.question: What New England Patriots quarterback won his first Super Bowl after the 2001 season?
100.explanation: Tom Brady replaced the injured Drew Bledsoe in 2001 and led the Patriots to an upset of the St. Louis Rams in Super Bowl XXXVI.

200.question: What Patriots coach partnered with Tom Brady for multiple Super Bowl wins?
200.explanation: Bill Belichick and Tom Brady won six Super Bowls together with the Patriots, the most successful coach-quarterback pairing in NFL history.

300.question: What team defeated the previously unbeaten Patriots in Super Bowl XLII?
300.explanation: The New York Giants beat the 18-0 Patriots 17-14 in Super Bowl XLII, helped by David Tyree's famous helmet catch.

400.question: What Colts quarterback was one of the defining passers of the 2000s and won Super Bowl XLI?
400.explanation: Peyton Manning, a five-time MVP, beat the Chicago Bears in Super Bowl XLI with the Colts and later won Super Bowl 50 with the Broncos.

500.question: What Saints quarterback led New Orleans to its first Super Bowl win after the 2009 season?
500.explanation: Drew Brees led the Saints past the Indianapolis Colts in Super Bowl XLIV, a lift for New Orleans after Hurricane Katrina.

100.question: What Kansas City Chiefs quarterback became one of the defining stars of the late 2010s and 2020s?
100.explanation: Patrick Mahomes, known for no-look and off-platform throws, has led the Chiefs to multiple Super Bowl titles.

200.question: What Seattle Seahawks defensive backfield was nicknamed the Legion of Boom?
200.explanation: The Legion of Boom secondary, led by Richard Sherman, Earl Thomas, and Kam Chancellor, powered Seattle's 43-8 win over Denver in Super Bowl XLVIII.

300.question: What Eagles quarterback caught a touchdown pass in the Philly Special during Super Bowl LII?
300.explanation: On the Philly Special trick play, quarterback Nick Foles caught a touchdown pass from Trey Burton. Foles was MVP of the Eagles' Super Bowl LII win over the Patriots.

400.question: What Rams defensive tackle became one of the dominant defensive players of the 2010s?
400.explanation: Aaron Donald won three Defensive Player of the Year awards with the Rams and helped them win Super Bowl LVI.

500.question: What Buccaneers quarterback won Super Bowl LV after leaving New England?
500.explanation: Tom Brady joined Tampa Bay in 2020 and beat the Chiefs in Super Bowl LV, his seventh Super Bowl title.
